title: Send feedback
description: Tell us what works, what doesn't, and what you'd like to see next. Your report goes directly to the Asynchrone Space team.
descriptionFor: Tell us what works, what doesn't, and what you'd like to see next in {organization}. Your report goes directly to the Asynchrone Space team.
formDescription: The questions adapt to what you are reporting.
titleRequired: Add a summary of at least 3 characters.
descriptionRequired: Describe the issue or idea in at least 10 characters.
pageHint: Pre-filled with the page you are on; adjust it if needed.
contactEmailHint: We may reply to this address if we need more details.
allowContactLabel: I'm happy to be contacted about this feedback
allowContactHint: We may ask a follow-up question or invite you to a short call.
screenshotHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB.
screenshotInvalidType: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images are supported.
screenshotTooLarge: The image must be 5 MB or smaller.
successDescription: Your report has been sent to the Asynchrone Space team.
successNotDelivered: Your report was recorded in the server logs, but email delivery is not configured in this environment.
privacyNote: Your report is sent by email to the Asynchrone Space team and is not shown to your organization.
